cohort: 2,125 last-born infants born within 24 months before the 2019 Ethiopia mini-demographic and health survey
finding: Higher preceding birth interval, gestational age, antenatal care visits, facility-based delivery, vaginal delivery, and higher maternal education were associated with higher odds of early breastfeeding initiation, while rural residence and older maternal age were associated with lower odds.
mod_finding: Rural mothers who delivered by cesarean section had a lower prevalence of early breastfeeding initiation.
